done_when: A prototype fix's review prompt says the Prototype before sign-off allowance is recorded by Forge and covers any size and interface changes, and no longer asks the reviewer to check that allowance against the diff; other allowances keep the check; a test proves both
why: Forge records Prototype before sign-off on every client prototype fix, but the fix review tells the reviewer to check it as an agent-recorded allowance, so every prototype fix that adds an interface gets a blocking allowance-mismatch finding it cannot fix
